title: Word counter
summary: A small command-line word counter, like wc: lines, words and characters of a text file.

requirements.title: Count a text
requirements.description: The package wordcount exposes count(text: str) -> dict with the integer keys lines, words and chars. lines is the number of newline characters, words the number of whitespace-separated words, chars the number of characters.

criteria.then: it returns lines 2, words 3 and chars 14
it returns lines 0, words 0 and chars 0

requirements.title: Count a file from the command line
requirements.description: python -m wordcount <file> prints the three counts and the file name, separated by single spaces, on one line.

criteria.when: python -m wordcount is run with its path
criteria.then: it prints "2 3 14 <path>" and exits with status 0

criteria.given: a path where no file exists
criteria.when: python -m wordcount is run with it
criteria.then: it exits with status 1, prints nothing on stdout and names the path on stderr

quality.target: count answers for a 1 MB text in under 1 second

constraints: Python 3.11 or later, standard library only.
The package is wordcount/ at the project root: wordcount/__init__.py defines count, wordcount/__main__.py the command line.
Tests live in tests/ and run with pytest from the project root.
